title: Delegated administrator for AWS services that work with Organizations
note: Amendment 2, round 4 (batch F8, q-saa-1-1-k01-mr distractor fix): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com. Confirms delegated administrator status registers a member account as administrator for a specific compatible AWS service's organization-wide feature; it does not by itself grant that account's IAM roles permission to read resources in member accounts outside that service's own mechanism.
